name: Maniac
description: Two strangers are drawn to a mysterious pharmaceutical trial that will, they're assured, with no complications or side-effects whatsoever, solve all of their problems, permanently. Things do not go as planned.

videos.title: The Chosen One!
videos.overview: Diagnosed with schizophrenia, Owen is the black sheep of the wealthy Milgrim clan. After losing his job, he enrolls in an experimental drug trial.

videos.title: Windmills
videos.overview: When her pilfered stash of pills runs out, troubled Annie tries to quit -- but ends up blackmailing her way into the Neberdine study.

videos.title: Having a Day
videos.overview: Muramoto notices irregularities in Annie and Owen's data. He questions Owen, who recalls the worst night of his life: his brother's engagement party.

videos.title: Furs by Sebastian
videos.overview: After taking the B pill, Annie and Owen find themselves on 1980s Long Island entangled in a strange caper involving a lemur.

videos.title: Exactly Like You
videos.overview: Annie and Owen are Arlie and Ollie, grifters attending a séance at the mysterious Neberdine mansion in the 1940s.

videos.title: Larger Structural Issues
videos.overview: Azumi tells James the whole truth about the study's snags and urges him to call his estranged mother, an esteemed therapist.

videos.title: Ceci N'est Pas Une Drill
videos.overview: Owen and Annie take the C pill. No longer connected, he belongs to a Mafia family, and she's a medieval guide hired by an ailing elf princess.

videos.title: The Lake of the Clouds
videos.overview: Annia and Ellia continue their quest, and Owen's mafioso father pressures him to protect the family. Greta counsels a bereaved Gertie.

videos.title: Utangatta
videos.overview: Owen and Annie meet again as a disgraced Icelandic spy and a CIA operative who helps him. Greta implores James to shut down the trial.

videos.title: Option C
videos.overview: After the subjects are discharged, James and Azumi face Neberdine's CEO. Owen and Annie part ways -- until a startling headline sparks a reunion.
